asked.item: Credit cost of one nano-banana-pro image
Whether the balance covers the planned posts

verdict.reason: The pages give the per-image credit cost of nano-banana-pro and say to compare the balance with the whole job's cost.

steps.text: Before generating, compare your balance with the cost of the entire job.
A positive balance still fails the check when the total is higher.
You can buy more AI credits at any time in Settings > Billing.
